checks.name: Native missing, busy and permission categories remain distinct from DNS failure
Missing file fails once; actual directory listing and fresh read recover the renamed file
One transient file busy retries once with fresh bytes/version, distinct internal ID and one admission
Persistent file busy exhausts two reads, without unsupported or unknown effect
Permission failure and in-read file version conflict never retry
Busy copy is never replayed, retains uncertain effect and creates no target
Stop during registered retry wait cancels promptly and dispatches no second Hana read

scope: Actual Hana file IO and execution boundary, owned synthetic filesystem failures; not provider or UI acceptance
